The weak forces between layers of metal atoms

questions.explanation: Metallic bonding is the strong electrostatic attraction between positive metal ions (arranged in a regular lattice) and the delocalised electrons (free to move throughout the structure). The delocalised electrons are sometimes described as a 'sea of electrons'.
